2026-11-23.title: Environment variables
2026-11-23.description: Define personal variables under Settings > Environment Variables and reference them in skills using {{PLACEHOLDER}}. Values are substituted automatically when skills are exposed through MCP, and missing variables are flagged next to Skills in the sidebar.

2026-11-23.title: Change your password
2026-11-23.description: You can now update your password directly under Settings.
